title: Roamly eSIM: landed, connected, before the bags

product.name: Roamly
product.one_liner: travel eSIM app: pick a country, install, data works when you land

audience: people 22-40 who fly a few times a year and still buy airport SIM cards

presenter.description: fictional man, late twenties, backpack, airport; generated, not based on anyone

hook.why: Direct instruction against the viewer's default habit, said where the habit happens.

style: airport phone footage, mixed fluorescent and window light, handheld, slightly rushed

shots.visual: Presenter walks past an airport SIM kiosk with a queue and shakes his head at the camera
shots.caption:
don't buy the airport SIM
AI-generated ad

prompt.subject: fictional man in his late twenties with a backpack walking through an airport arrivals hall past a generic phone kiosk with a short queue
prompt.action: he glances at the kiosk, shakes his head at the lens and keeps walking
prompt.negative: readable brand names, flags, text, logos

shots.visual: Presenter stopped by a pillar, holding up a passport and a tiny SIM tray tool, fumbling
shots.caption: passport, queue, tiny tray, lost SIM
shots.voiceover: Queue, passport, the tiny tray tool, and your home SIM ends up in a jacket pocket forever.

prompt.subject: the same fictional man leaning on an airport pillar, holding a passport and a SIM ejector pin, fumbling with a phone
prompt.action: he juggles the passport and the pin, nearly drops the pin, looks at the lens

shots.visual: Screen recording: open app, tap the destination country, tap install, the eSIM profile appears in phone settings
shots.caption: tap the country. tap install. done.
shots.voiceover: Before you fly: open the app, tap the country, tap install. The eSIM sits in your settings next to your normal SIM.

shots.visual: Presenter at the gate on arrival, phone shows signal bars and a maps route to the hotel loading
shots.caption: landed. maps loads at the gate.
shots.voiceover: Then you land, airplane mode off, and the map loads at the gate while everyone else is in the queue.

prompt.subject: the fictional man walking off a jet bridge holding up a phone with a map route on screen
prompt.action: he walks toward the lens, turns the phone to show the screen and grins

shots.visual: Screen recording: the plan page with the data amount, validity days and price shown, then the country list
shots.caption: price and days shown before you pay
shots.voiceover: Data, days and price are on the plan page before you pay. No contract.

shots.visual: Presenter walks toward the exit doors, points at the camera then down
shots.caption: install it before your next flight. link below.
shots.voiceover: Install it before your next flight. Link below.

prompt.subject: the fictional man walking toward airport exit doors with his backpack, pointing at the lens then downward
prompt.action: he points at the camera, then down, and walks through the doors

claims.evidence: terms of service: prepaid plans only; checked on the filming date

cta.text: Install it before your next flight. Link below.
cta.on_screen: install it before your next flight. link below.

notes: No coverage, speed or 'works in every country' claims; coverage differs per plan and the plan page is the source.
No real airline, airport or carrier branding in generated shots (negative prompt covers logos and flags).
Prices are never spoken or captioned; they change per country and would go stale.
